notes.title: Astonishing Basketball 24 upgrade!
notes.content:
Hi basketball fans!

With the playoffs starting, we thought it was a good time to release a major update to [b]Astonishing Basketball[/b] for PC! While it includes a lot of quality-of-life changes and bug fixes, it also prepares the ground for more, bigger features to be released later.

[list]
[*] Players will now sometimes react when you try to trade them. And even better, you will be able to reply to them directly in the inbox!
[*] Chefs will no longer potentially retire after just one year of good services
[*] Small improvements for awards
[*] Improved Timeshift UI for players
[*] There can be only one game MVP, so we've improved the selection process 
[*] Improve your PG and C with the new big and roll strategy. We really can't stop Andy now
[*] Will you let your players go? No! Congratulate them after they've signed that contract extension, directly from the inbox!
[*] New sort option in the team picker
[*] Bug fixes for franchise player, achievements, trades
[*] Improved jersey sales UI
[*] Bug fixes for franchise player, trades, scouts and universities
[*] Unhappy players won't ask you for an extension anymore
[*] Bug fixes for random events and the Alumni Cup
[/list]

To celebrate, we're also discounting the game this week. The perfect way to celebrate basketball!

Enjoy the update, and see you on the court!

notes.title: The Big and roll update
notes.content:
Hi basketball fans!

We have some exciting content for this new update! From new way to experience the on-court action to new strategies and new options to make your important job even easier! So without further ado, here is what you can expect in this update:

📣 Player Empowerment: Players react to trades, and you can respond directly in the inbox!
👨‍🍳 Job Security for Chefs: They won't retire after just one year of good service anymore!
🏆 Award Season: Small but important improvements to awards!
📊 Timeshift Made Better: Enhanced UI for players!
🌟 MVP Selection: Only one game MVP - now with an improved selection process!
🏀 Big & Roll Strategy: Boost your PG and C; Andy can't be stopped!
📝 Contract Celebrations: Congratulate players on contract extensions right from your inbox!
🔍 Team Sorting: New sorting option in the team picker!
👕 Jersey Sales Upgrade: Improved UI for jersey sales!
😔 No More Extension Requests: Unhappy players won't ask for extensions anymore!
🐞 Bug Squashing: Fixes for franchise player, trades, scouts, universities, achievements, random events, and Alumni Cup!

Feel free to let us know if you have any feedback on this new update!

notes.title: New Rosters are in town
notes.content:
Hey basketball fans! This week, we have a big update, with a lot of cool stuff for everybody! Among many things, our rosters have been updated, and plenty of new names have been added to the game.
You will also be able to show how cool your team is thanks to our new logos!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118971/c172a627c5625cff232cd30098aae3a9300550dd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118971/2c2d7324510ca6ce53eb5e688906a162c7dbcc3e.png[/img][/url]

On top of all these new features, we've also included a few bug fixes. It never hurts to make the game more stable!

If you have any trouble with the update, or want to share suggestions, feel free to send a support email!
Thanks for playing!

[b]Complete changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] Rosters have been updated!
[*] The HOF election process has been made more realistic
[*] Draft projections now consider traded picks
[*] Improvements for the stadium menu and the bleachers messages
[*] We’ve added a thousand new player names to the game!
[*] New shiny logos are now available for your team!
[*] New individual game records will now be celebrated by the fans
[*] AI Coaches being fired will sometimes trigger news messages
[*] The Astonishing Zoo has finally arrived in town! 
[*] Bug fixes for minor teams, the rivalry and popularity
[/list]

notes.title: It's a deal!
notes.content:
A new update for Astonishing Basketball is available, and it's bringing to you a complete "transactions" page! You will now be able to see all the roster transactions you've made during the season, as well as the reactions of the media!

On top of that, we're introducing a new version of "Timeshift", our in-game decision component. More fun for every coach!

[b]Complete changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] Transactions page, available in the front office
[*] Timeshift V2 now allows you to make even more interesting in-game decisions!
[*] Legends Contest rosters will now be properly organized 
[*] Improved universities UI, standings UI, the draft and much more!
[/list]

notes.title: The Rings Update
notes.content:
Hey basketball fans!

This week, we bring you a brand new update, with a lot of cool content. This version includes the "collectable rings", that you can earned each time you win a championship!

We've also included a lot of other cool features, like the new championship parades, or the minor team coach skills!

Here's our complete changelog: 
[list]
[*] Collect rings when you win the Basketball Cup, and celebrate with the new championship parades!
[*] Make your minor team coach even better with the brand new skills!
[*] The defense rating in the roster screen will now be the same as in the player details page!
[*] The awards screen will now display your best scoring season!
[*] Bug fixes for followers and scouts (thanks Moose and Andy!)
[/list]

Hope you enjoy this new update!

notes.title: You're the MVP!
notes.content:
Hey fans!

We have a brand new update for [b]Astonishing Basketball[/b]! It includes many changes and bug fixes, including the new "Game's MVP" card, which celebrates the best player of every game!

I hope you will enjoy this new version! New features should also be available in the next update, and the franchise player mode is also on the way. I know many of you have been asking for it, so don't worry, it's coming!

[b]Complete changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] Celebrate great performances thanks to the new "Game's MVP" card in the post-game screen!
[*] Timeshift has been improved with new game situations
[*] The league will now celebrate your players' milestones!
[*] Brand new default avatars!
[*] Basketball Cup parade messages have been improved and fixed.
[*] You will now receive a reminder for your university (Thanks Andy!)
[*] Improved UI for player training and tasks
[*] Bug fixes for parade messages and random events
[*] Bug fixes for minor team standings, FA contracts and the awards screen
[/list]

notes.title: Astonishing Basketball V3.4.3
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the latest update for Astonishing Basketball!
Even though this one doesn't introduce flashy new features, it actually improve a lot of things based on the community's feedback!

[list]
[*] Separate stats for defensive and offensive rebounds in boxscore
[*] Easily pick portraits for front office coaches
[*] 5M button for faster contract offers
[*] KATE upgrade with new features
[*] Restructured help section
[*] Bug fixes for scouts, power rankings, and the Prodigy player
[/list]

Thank you for playing ABK and sharing your feedback. I hope you enjoy these new features and improvements!

notes.title: Back to school
notes.content:
Hey basketball fans!

We're back this week with an update that is all about universities!

[b]My University[/b] is a new feature that allows you to join the board of directors of one of the game's universities. Help them decide on their budget, enact policies, request new buildings, and make sure to keep a high reputation, or the other directors might just override you!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118971/efe4fb119673def89ba2a689dd6c2ff7e004130f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118971/4d6fc0ad48034069cf3f1dfcaee671c651f1f6aa.jpg[/img][/url]

On top of that, we've added a few new messages to improve the narrative immersion, and we've crushed a few bugs as well!

I hope you'll enjoy this update. Have fun!

[b]Complete changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] My university: join the board of directors and help the university become legendary!
[*] Your scouts will now send you a report after the draft to tell you how accurate they've been.
[*] Improved messages for transactions
[*] The total of 3s scored in a player's career is now displayed
[*] Bug fixes for mods
[*] UI fixes for various screens
[/list]

notes.title: All about basketball
notes.content:
Hey basketball fans!

This week's update is all about narrative content! What do I mean by that? Well, first of all, your players will now send you messages from time to time, expression their frustration or satisfaction. For example, they might celebrate last night's win, or complain about an humiliating loss. 

But there is more! Trade rumors can now appear in the bleachers feed, and your retired players might kindly ask you to retire their number in your stadium!

I hope you will enjoy this new update, and remember that you can also send me an email whenever you want!

Finally, I also wanted to add that I'm gonna write an article about the game's monetization, in order to explain why it's not free, and why I've included micro-transactions. I've received legit questions on that topic, and I think an article will be a good format to talk about that.

Enjoy the game!

[b]Complete Changelog[/b]
[list]
[*] Your players will now send you a message from time to time, sharing what's on their mind (basketball, hopefully)
[*] Players might ask that you retire their number at your stadium (Thanks SJ!)
[*] Trade rumors might now appear in your feed. How mysterious!
[*] Teams in the HOF screen are now sorted by alphabetical order, with your team first. 
[*] Custom mod support has been improved
[*] Teammates will spend less time attacking each other in the medias, and will instead share more love
[*] Bug fix for traits and the stadium chef (Thanks Andy!)
[/list]

notes.title: We've launched!
notes.content:
Hey Astonishing Basketball fans! 
I'm thrilled to announce that the game is now available on Steam in early access. This is a major milestone for the game, and one that wouldn't have been possible without our entire community, on Discord and elsewhere!

If you haven't already, be sure to check out the early access version on Steam and join the thousands of players already competing for the Basketball Cup. I really want to make this the best basketball game ever created on PC, and your feedback will be crucial to accomplish this! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2170680/Astonishing_Basketball_Manager/?utm_source=scom

Sounds interesting? Here are some of the features you can expect:
[list]
[*] Customizable roster: Sign and trade players to build the ultimate team, or use a community-made rosters to explore all kind of scenarios
[*] Intuitive tactics system: Fine-tune your strategy to outmaneuver your opponents and lead your team to victory.
[*] Deep draft system: you will have the opportunity to scout and recruit the best prospects from around the world. But the competition for top talent is fierce, so you'll need to use all of your scouting resources wisely in order to secure the best players!
[*] Make your team truly yours: hire talented assistants, coaches and scouts to make your success a true team effort!
[*] Stadium customization: Create shops, organize events, and even hire a chef to keep your stadium running smoothly. Keep tourists happy and watch your revenue soar.
[*] Personalize everything: rename and customize any player, team, or university!
[*] Dynamic in-game events, aka Timeshift: Keep your team on their toes with unexpected challenges and opportunities that can arise during games.
[/list]

Thank you for your support, and stay tuned. There's more coming up soon!
